definitions.explanation: A sharp-bladed knife used for cutting and preparing food in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: {包丁|ほうちょう}で{野菜|やさい}を{切|き}る。
examples.english: Cut vegetables with a kitchen knife.

examples.notes: 研ぐ is the verb for sharpening blades

examples.japanese: この{包丁|ほうちょう}は{切|き}れ{味|あじ}がいい。
examples.english: This knife has a good cutting edge.
examples.notes: 切れ味 refers to sharpness/cutting quality

notes:
Types of Japanese kitchen knives:
- {三徳|さんとく}{包丁|ぼうちょう} (santoku) - all-purpose, most common in Japanese homes
- {牛刀|ぎゅうとう} (gyuto) - chef's knife, Western-style
- {出刃|でば}{包丁|ぼうちょう} (deba) - thick blade for fish filleting
- {柳刃|やなぎば}/{刺身|さしみ}{包丁|ぼうちょう} - long, thin blade for slicing sashimi
- {菜切|なき}り{包丁|ぼうちょう} - vegetable knife, rectangular blade
- ペティナイフ - small utility knife

Famous production areas: {堺|さかい} (Osaka), {関|せき} (Gifu), {燕三条|つばめさんじょう} (Niigata).

Collocations:
- {包丁|ほうちょう}を{入|い}れる (to cut into)
- {包丁|ほうちょう}さばき (knife skills)
